court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. M.S. Prem Kumar Government Advocate
judgment_text:
Contempt petition filed under Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act, praying to issue summons to the respondents for willful disobedience of the Court order made in W.P. No. 4931 of 2024 dated 28-2-2024 and punish them under Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Velmurugan, J.:— This contempt petition has been filed alleging willful disobedience of the order dated 28-2-2024 in W.P. No. 4931 of 2024.

2. Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned government advocate appearing for the respondents submitted that the order of this Court dated 28-2-2024 in W.P. No. 4931 of 2024 has been complied with. In support of the same, he has produced a copy of the proceedings dated 27-11-2025 to that effect.

3. Recording the same, the contempt petition is closed. If the petitioner is aggrieved by the said order, it is open to him to challenge the same in the manner known to law.
